the development of new methods for the fabrication of high performance CNT based electronic and optoelectronic devices.
the fabrication and analysis of CNT based electronic and photonic devices.

the removal of polymer from FESA films is possible and the resulting devices are as good as those with polymer.

we have demonstrated a new method to fabricate electronic grade aligned S CNT array for scalable device fabrication.
this work demonstrates that polymer removal is possible in a scalable fashion, without adversely affecting the electronic properties of S CNTs.
we demonstrate the ability to completely remove polymer wrapper from large diameter S C NTs in a scalable manner without affecting the electronic properties of S CNTs.

the McAPR process can be applied to other conjugated polymer sorted CNT arrays for the fabrication of electronic and optoelectronic devices.
